dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: If I want to leave Sumeru and go all the way to Snezhnaya for a performance, I need a break long enough to make the trip.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: It has to be approved by the Akademiya, and it has to be one that does not get derailed by research deadlines, evaluations, reviews, or whatever academic exchange comes up next.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: I just wish I could see a little more... even ten more minutes.

dialogues.speaker: Vidya
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let me sit here a little longer. There might still be an encore. Otherwise, I don't know when I'll ever get to sit in this theater again.
